state: V_mV, cai_mM, 18 ion gates, synaptic receptor/plasticity/event cursor/RNG state. A future compact model must declare the causal replacement for each retained or removed variable.
inputs: injected current density, physical parameters, presynaptic events available at their causal time, explicit random draws or RNG state. Trial-V interface for later composition is tested in CC-17.
initialization: Initial physical state encoder permitted only at initialization; alternatively causal warmup. No teacher state resets during autonomous evaluation.
units: V mV; time ms; cai mM; current density mA/cm2; gbar S/cm2; synaptic conductance uS; area um2. Positive ionic/synaptic current is outward; injected current positive inward.
behavioral_policy: Adaptation/recovery/frequency and stochastic-distribution specifications require dedicated support and preregistration before N4; this phase cannot certify them. No unconditional promotion of an architecture from N1.
split_policy: Group whole episodes and conditioning families; no adjacent-window leakage. Fit/development/sealed separated; old Task35 data diagnostic only. New sealed episodes generated only after candidate freeze in CC-19.
speed_policy: At least 10% paired median wall latency reduction with paired bootstrap lower 95% bound >0 against symmetric optimized formula and frozen hybrid baselines at registered workload in CC-18/19. N1 only diagnoses cost; no speed promotion.
